source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of atomic spectra (PDF 189).

blocks.text: Jab atoms kisi khaas wavelength ki roshni emit (chhorte) ya absorb (jazb) karte hain to atomic spectra nazar aate hain; inhein respectively (bil-tarteeb) emission spectra aur absorption spectra kehte hain. Atomic spectra is baat ka evidence (saboot) hain ke atom ke electrons sirf khaas, alag alag (discrete) energy levels ke darmiyan hi ja sakte hain. Jab atom ke electrons energy absorb karte hain to woh neeche ke energy levels se oopar ke levels par chale jate hain. Yeh excited (oopar gaye hue) electrons wapas ground state mein aate hue energy chhorte hain aur emission spectra banate hain.

blocks.alt: Oopar: kaali patti par 410, 434, 486 aur 656 nm par chaar rangeen lines, axis Wavelength, lambda (nm). Neeche: energy levels n = 2, 3, 4 aur 5, aur n = 3 (pink), n = 4 (light blue) aur n = 5 (dark blue) se n = 2 tak teen mote neeche jaate teer; har aik se usi rang ka wavy (lehar-numa) photon baen taraf nikalta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 29.2: Hydrogen ka emission spectrum (kitab ki Figure 29.2 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har teer aik electron ka oopar ke level se n = 2 par girna hai, aur har girne par aik photon (wavy teer) nikalta hai. Jitna bara gap (farq), utni zyada energy aur utni chhoti wavelength: n = 3 se n = 2 red (surkh) 656 nm line deta hai, n = 4 se n = 2 blue-green 486 nm, aur n = 5 se n = 2 blue (neeli) 434 nm. Patti mein chauthi line 410 nm n = 6 se n = 2 se aati hai; kitab ka diagram sirf teen teer dikhata hai.
Emission spectra kam pressure wali gas ko garam kar ke banaye ja sakte hain. Garmi electrons ko oopar ke energy levels tak le jane ke liye energy deti hai.

Jab electron wapas neeche ke energy level par aata hai to woh aik photon chhorta hai. Har aisi chhalang (transition) roshni ki aik khaas wavelength deti hai jo spectrum mein aik spectral line (lakeer) ki shakal mein dikhti hai. Is tarah emission spectrum mein kuch alag alag wavelengths hoti hain jo kaale background par rangeen lines ki shakal mein nazar aati hain.

Doosri taraf, absorption spectrum mein ground state ke electrons energy absorb kar ke oopar ke levels par jate hain, aur guzarne wali roshni mein dark bands (kaali lakeerein) reh jati hain. Absorption spectra white (safaid) roshni ko thandi, kam pressure wali gas se guzar kar banaye ja sakte hain. Sirf woh photons absorb hote hain jin ki energy electrons ko excite karne ke liye bilkul barabar ho. Har absorb hua photon aik khaas wavelength ka hota hai jo rangeen background par kaali line ki shakal mein dikhta hai. Yeh lines usi element ke emission spectrum ki lines wali jagah par hi hoti hain. Absorption spectrum goya emission spectrum ka photographic negative hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar: violet se red tak continuous (musalsal) rangeen band jis par 410, 434, 486 aur 656 nm par kaali lines hain, axis Wavelength, lambda (nm). Neeche: energy levels n = 2, 3, 4 aur 5, aur n = 2 se n = 3 (pink), n = 4 (light blue) aur n = 5 (dark blue) tak teen mote oopar jaate teer; har teer tak usi rang ka wavy (lehar-numa) photon baen taraf se aata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 29.3: Hydrogen ka absorption spectrum (kitab ki Figure 29.3 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Absorption mein ulta hota hai: white light ke wohi photons absorb hote hain jin ki energy kisi gap ke barabar ho, aur electron n = 2 se oopar chala jata hai. Isi liye rangeen band mein bilkul unhi wavelengths (410, 434, 486, 656 nm) par kaali lines hain jahan emission mein chamakdar lines thin.

blocks.prompt: Kisi element ke absorption spectrum ki kaali lines us ke emission spectrum ki chamakdar lines wali wavelengths par hi kyun hoti hain?
blocks.explanation: Dono unhi energy levels ke darmiyan transitions (chhalangon) se bante hain. Absorption mein electron farq jitni energy le kar oopar jata hai aur emission mein utni hi energy chhor kar neeche aata hai, is liye photon ki energy aur wavelength dono mein aik jaisi hoti hai.

items: Emission: kaale background par rangeen lines (electrons neeche girte hain).
Absorption: rangeen spectrum par kaali lines (electrons oopar jate hain).
